On 26 September 2018, at least one person was killed and several injured in a fight between two Dalit groups in Nagla Bajurg village near Muzaffarnagar (Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh). It was apparently over a 'minor dispute' - no further details given.

On 26 September 2018, students at Banaras Hindu University in Varanasi (Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh) staged a protest against the administration for ordering students to vacate hostels after an incident of violence earlier in the week.

On 26 September 2018, incidents of violence were reported from Paschim Burdhwan district (West Bengal), as BJP and TMC supporters clashed with each other. The group was enforcing a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, Trinamool Congress and BJP supporters clashed in Cooch Behar district (West Bengal), as the BJP members were supporting a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur. The police intervened with baton charge and tear gas shells. There were reports of vandalized property, including state-run buses.

On 26 September 2018, incidents of violence were reported from Dakshin Dinajpur district (West Bengal), as BJP and TMC supporters clashed with each other. The group was enforcing a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters were arrested at Naxalbari area (Darjeeling district, West Bengal), as they were trying to enforce a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters staged a demonstration and blocked trains at Andul railway station, in Dhuilya city (Howrah district, West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, rioters vandalized state-run buses in Howrah district (West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters staged a demonstration and blocked trains at Ramrajatala railway station in Howrah city (Howrah district, West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters staged protests in Kolkata city (Kolkata district, West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, around 12 Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) members were detained after clashing with police in Kolkata city (Kolkata district, West Bengal). The group was enforcing a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, SFI activists took out a protest march to Raj Bhawan, in Kolkata city (Kolkata district, West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur. They demanded an impartial judicial probe into the deaths.

On 26 September 2018, over 6,000 coal officers from Jharkhand gheraoed and staged dharna in front of the Coal India Limited (CIL) Kolkata headquarters in Kolkata city (West Bengal), demanding rationalisation of pay scale between executive and non-executive staff.

On 26 September 2018, Trinamool Congress and BJP supporters clashed in Nadia district (West Bengal), as the BJP members were supporting a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur. The police intervened with baton charge and tear gas shells.

On 26 September 2018, clashes broke out between BJP and TMC workers in Barasat area (North 24 Parganas district, West Bengal), when the BJP workers were trying to obstruct movement of trains. The group was enforcing a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur. NH 34 was blocked by BJP supporters.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters protested and blocked NH 34 in Madhyamgram area (North 24 Parganas district, West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters set three state buses on fire in Jhargram district (West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, incidents of violence were reported from Paschim Medinipur district (West Bengal), as BJP and TMC supporters clashed with each other. The group was enforcing a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters were arrested at Canning area (South 24 Parganas district, West Bengal), as they were trying to enforce a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters created road blockades by felling tree trunks and burning tyres in the Islampur area (Uttar Dinajpur district, West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur. There were reports of clashes with the police, and two buses were also set on fire.

On 26 September 2018, incidents of violence were reported from Uttar Dinajpur district (West Bengal), as BJP and TMC supporters clashed with each other. The group was enforcing a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 26 September 2018, BJP supporters attacked cars in Malda area (Malda district, West Bengal), in support of a bandh called by the BJP after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur. Report does not mention whether cars were occupied.

On 26 September 2018, students of Dhanamanjuri University protested and burnt an effigy of Manipur Chief Minister on their college campus, in Imphal city (Imphal West district, Manipur), demanding the release of the arrested Manipur University students and teachers. The police tried to disperse the students with tear gas shells.

On 27 September 2018, two groups of TMC members with one including a former panch (local government head) clashed at Haskari village in Majhiali block area (Uttar Dinajpur district, WB) over an unreported issue. One person was shot at and he was left injured in the incident.
On 27 September 2018, in Tandavapura village in Nanjangud tehsil (Mysuru, Karnataka), villagers staged a protest demanding a job for one if their family members.
On 27 September 2018, a teenager was lynched by family of the village pradhan, in Jatpura village (Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh) after being caught with his granddaughter.
On 27 September 2018, a youth was tied to an electricity pole and beaten by a mob who accused him of having a relationship with a woman in the town, in Meeraganj (Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh).
On 27 September 2018, in Vijayawada town (Krishna, AP), SFI activists staged a demonstration demanding action against private and corporate colleges for being a cause of increasing student suicides.
On 27 September 2018, in Vijayawada town (Krishna, AP), students staged a demonstration demanding the government to immediately release a DSC notification of 1,056 vacant posts across the state.
On 27 September 2018, in Vizianagaram town (Vizianagaram, AP), sanitary workers and YSR Congress Party activists staged a demonstration demanding timely payment of wages.

On 27 September 2018, the Garo Autonomous Council Joint Movement Committee (GACJMC) staged dharna at Dispur Last Gate in Guwahati city (Kamrup Metropolitan district, Assam), to demand the creation of a Garo Autonomous Council.

On 27 September 2018, locals and hundreds of members of the Bajrang Dal protested in the market area of Bettiah city (Paschim Champaran , Bihar), after a student died and eight others were injured after the roof of a school classroom collapsed on September 25.

On 27 September 2018, students groups from Panjab University, including Students for Society, NSUI, Sath, Punjab Students Union, AISA, SFI, Indian Students Association, and Pal Pehalwan Students Organisation staged a protest march at Panab University in Chandigarh (Chandigarh), demanding that Punjabi be declared the University's official language rather than Hindi.
On 27 September 2018, in Junagadh town (Junagadh, Gujarat), people staged a protest against the assault of the Bajrang Dal activists on September 26.

On 27 September 2018, in Halvad town (Morbi, Gujarat), Hindu and Muslim activists staged a demonstration, set shops on fire, and clashed with one another, during a demonstration condemning the assault of the Bajrang Dal activists on September 26.

On 27 September 2018, in Patan town (Patan, Gujarat), Patidar Anamat Andolan Samiti (PAAS) and National Students Union of India (NSUI) activists staged a demonstration and vandalized university property demanding reinstatement of an employee who was removed one month ago.
On 27 September 2018, sugarcane farmers began a protest dharna at the Minister of State's office in Indri (Karnal, Haryana) demanding payment of back dues to the Piccadily Sugar Mill.

On 27 September 2018, labourers staged a protest dharna in the grain market at Karnal (Karnal, Haryana) against the authorities for not ensuring that labourers have clean drinking water, after the recent deaths of 6 people due to diarrhoea and poor drinking water in the city.
On 27 September 2018, the HPSEB Employees Union staged a protest in Mandi (Mandi, Himachal Pradesh) against the state government for planning to unbundle the HPSEB, which was not in their interest.

On 27 September 2018, supporters of state INTUC president Hardeep Singh Bawa rioted and vandalized some vehicles after he was attacked by unidentified assailants earlier in the day, near Parwanoo (Solan, Himachal Pradesh).
On 27 Sep, rioters clashed with government forces in the Dialgam area (Anantnag, J&K) in response to CASOs staged in the district.
On 27 Sep, rioters clashed with government forces in the Larkipora area (Anantnag, J&K) in response to CASOs staged in the district.
On 27 Sep, the POJK DP's Front staged a protest at the Press Club in Jammu city (J&K) against delays in the distribution of funds to Pakistani refugees.

On 27 Sep, students and NSF activists staged a protest at Jammu University in Jammu city (J&K) after they were refused permission to hold celebrations commemorating the second anniversary of India's 'surgical strikes' in Pakistan.
On 27 Sep, PM's package candidates staged a protest at the Press Club in Jammu city (J&K), calling for the release of the list of selected candidates.

On 27 Sep, the J&K Ex-Services League staged a protest rally at Kathua district town (J&K), raising a range of issues including annuities, delays in the provision of land grants, and the maintenance of gun licences for ex-servicemen.

On 27 Sep, students gathered at several locations in Srinagar city (J&K), including Kashmir University, to protest against the earlier shooting of a civilian by government forces in the Noorbagh area.

On 27 Sep, rioters clashed with government forces as mourners attempted to carry the body of a civilian was shot dead during a CASO to the Eidgarh area of Srinagar city (J&K). More that a dozen youth were injured when government forces responded to stone pelting with tear gas and pellet fire.

On 27 September 2018, BBMKU teachers held a demonstration at Lubi Circular Road in Dhanbad city (Dhanbad district, Jharkhand), and tied black badge to all authorities. The group demanded the implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission recommendations.
On 27 September 2018, in Kochi town (Ernakulam, Kerala), activists staged a protest against the vandalism of a Gandhi statue.
On 27 September 2018, in Mumbai city (Mumbai-City, Maha), Congress activists staged a protest march demanding the resignation of Prime Minister and Defence Minister over the Rafale deal.
On 27 September 2018, in Navi Mumbai (Thane, Maha), NCP activists staged a demonstration demanding an inquiry into the alleged scam in the Rafale deal.

On 27 September 2018, members of the Indo-Myanmar Labour Union (IMLU) held a peace-rally in Moreh city (Tengnoupal district, Manipur), against the planting of an Improvised Explosive Device (IED) by unknown militants near its office on September 25.

On 27 September 2018, demonstrators burnt tyres on the street in Imphal city (Imphal West district, Manipur), to enforce a 48-hour general strike called by students organizations against the police action towards the hostellers of Manipur University on September 20.

On 27 September 2018, members of the People Resurgence and Justice Alliance (PRJA) staged a protest and threw eggs at the photos of the Prime Minister and the Chief Minister in Imphal city (Imphal West district, Manipur). They condemned the arrest of students and teachers from the Manipur University on September 20.

On 27 September 2018, residents protested against engineers and officials visiting the site of a building collapse in Sawan Park / Wazirpur area of Delhi (Delhi). The collapse killed several, including children.

On 27 September 2018, fishers under the aegis of Chilika Matsyajibee Sangha staged a demonstration and burnt the effigy of a MLA in Puri district (Odisha). The group claimed the government is showing negligence in protecting the Chilika Lake and their livelihood.

On 27 September 2018, family of a woman who was injured in falling off the roof of a police jeep near Kathunagal police station, staged a protest in Amritsar (Amritsar, Punjab) demanding action against the officers involved in the mishap.

On 27 September 2018, street vendors protested near Lahori Gate Chowk and resisted against the Municipal Corporation attempts to remove encroachments, in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab). Police dispersed the protesters.

On 27 September 2018, farmers, led by Kisan Mazdoor Sangharsh Committee, staged a protest dharna and blocked rail lines at Patti town (Tarn Taran, Punjab). They were protesting against the government for failing to clear encroachments on a drain, which caused damage to paddy crops in the area. This marked day 4 of the protest.

On 27 September 2018, in Chennai city (Chennai, TN), automotive employees under the aegis of CITU staged a demonstration demanding the Korean Consulate's intervention to ensure higher wages and revoke the suspension of 15 employees.

On 27 September 2018, in Chennai city (Chennai, TN), Hindu employees at a local temple staged a demonstration demanding action against a BJP leader for making derogatory comments against the staff and their families.

On 27 September 2018, in Tirunelveli town (Tirunelveli, TN), Sri Lankan refugees staged a protest condemning police who were refusing to take action against an armed gang that hacked one of the refugee's relatives.
Assumed on September 27, in Wanaparthy town (Wanaparthy, Telangana), Congress activists staged a protest condemning the lack of sanitation in the district headquarters.

On 27 September 2018, family and residents rioted after around 12 children were injured in a school bus accident in Mau (Mau, Uttar Pradesh). Rioters threw stones and blocked the Ballia-Lucknow road, and set fire to several police vehicles. Police used force to disperse the crowd.

Around 27 September 2018, two man who sexually harassed girls in two separate cases in Muzaffarnagar town (Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh) were beaten by a group of onlookers and later handed over to police.

On 27 September 2018, two journalists were attacked by a local BJD MLA (Parsuram Dhada), in Soro area (Balasore district, Odisha). The journalists were taking pictures of the MLA, who was staging a dharna in front of the agriculture office, when they were attacked by the legislator and his supporters, leaving them critically injured. The dharna was irregularities in Biju Krushak Kalyan Yojana (BKKY).

On 27 September 2018, villagers held a demonstration in Dhanouti village under the Panapur police station area (Saran district, Bihar), after three workers, including a mason, died while working in a newly constructed pit toilet.

On 27 September 2018, activists representing Jan Adhikar Chattra Parishad (JASP) enforced a shutdown at Patna University, in Patna city (Bihar), to demonstrate against the alleged attack on the Patna Science College outgoing counsellor by unidentified man. The group of students also sat on dharna.

On 28 Sep, the JRL led a protest at Redwanibal in Kulgam district (J&K) against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar. Government forces used tear gas on protesters.

On 28 September 2018, in Balanagar tehsil (Mahbubnagar, Telangana), activists staged a demonstration against the district administration's move to help set up a chemical factory to manufacture drugs and medicines.
On 28 September 2018, in Pedda Amberpet town in Hayathnagar tehsil (Rangareddy, Telangana) CITU activists staged a demonstration demanding regularization of municipal outsourcing staff.

On 28 September 2018, retired employees staged a protest rally at Sector 17 in Chandigarh (Chandigarh) demanding the payment of pensions to retirees per the Supreme Court decision, and release of other payments.

On 28 September 2018, most chemists in Chandigarh participated in the national bandh called by the All-India Organisation of Chemists and Druggists, and staged a protest at Sector 19 in Chandigarh city (Chandigarh). Both protest and bandh were against the government's decision to allow online selling of pharmaceuticals.
On 28 September 2018, in Surat city (Surat, Gujarat), Congress activists and local residents staged a demonstration to protest against the number of alcohol-related deaths in the area.

On 28 September 2018, contractual garbage collectors in Ambala (Ambala, Haryana) staged a protest dharna at the MC there, demanding payment of back salaries. This marks day 3 of an ongoing strike by the workers.
On 28 September 2018, BKU members staged a protest at the Mini Secretariat in Kaithal (Kaithal, Haryana) demanding compensation for crops from the government after the recent poor weather conditions.

On 28 September 2018, Sikh devotees staged a demonstration and vandalized a fire truck after CM Manohar Lal Khattar cancelled his visit to the gurdwara in Dacher village (Karnal, Haryana), apparently over an image of Bhindranwale at the site.

Around 28 September 2018, family and associates of a woman who died in childbirth staged a protest at the Civil Hospital in Panchkula (Panchkula, Haryana), against the hospital claiming negligence and demanding action be taken against the doctors.

On 28 September 2018, students from Central University in Dharamsala (Kangra, Himachal Pradesh) staged a protest in front of the police station there against the police for failing to take action against a biker who struck and killed an MBA student.

On 28 Sep, the JRL led a protest at Ashajipora in Anantnag district town (J&K) against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar. Government forces used tear gas on protesters, leaving five protesters injured.

On 28 Sep, the JRL led a protest at Darin Qazigund Crossing in Anantnag district (J&K) against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar. Government forces used tear gas on protesters.

On 28 Sep, the JRL led a protest at Sopore town (Baramulla, J&K) against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar. Government forces used tear gas on protesters.

On 28 Sep, the JRL led a protest at Chadoora town (Budgam, J&K) against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar. Government forces used tear gas on protesters.

On 28 Sep, the JWAM staged an anti-Pakistan protest in Jammu city (J&K) on the second anniversary of India's 'surgical strikes' in Pakistan. Protesters burnt Pakistani flags and an effigy of Imran Khan during the demonstration.

On 28 Sep, the JRL led a protest at the Masjid Taqwa in Tral town (Pulwama, J&K) against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar.

On 28 Sep, the JKLF staged protest demonstrations in south, north and central Kashmir against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar.

On 28 Sep, the JRL led protests in the Soura, Natipora, Mehjoornagar, Parimpora and Lal Bazar areas of Srinagar city (J&K) against alleged human rights violations committed by government forces, following the earlier shooting of a civilian in Srinagar. Government forces used tear gas on protesters.
On 28 Sep, JKNPP supporters staged a rally in Ramnagar town (Udhampur, J&K) protesting against the BJP's record in government and calling for people to support the JKNPP in upcoming polls.

On 28 September 2018, an auto rickshaw was set on fire by a suspected bandh supporter at Keishampat in Imphal city (Imphal West district, Manipur), injuring two people who were inside the vehicle. The bandh was called by six students' bodies, demanding release of all the arrested students and teachers of the Manipur University.

On 28 September 2018, the Confederation of All India Traders called a bandh and staged a protest at Jantar Mantar in Delhi - Connaught Place (New Delhi, Delhi) against the sealing driving in and Walmart's role in the retail sector.

On 28 September 2018, BSP members and family staged a protest dharna at the office of Phillaur DSP in Phillaur (Jalandhar, Punjab) demanding the arrest of those responsible for killing a BSP member in Apra village on the 25th, and demanding relief and an income for the family.

On 28 September 2018, students from the Adesh Institute for Technology and Management staged a protest dharna on campus in Gharuan, near Kharar (Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab) accusing police and the administration of not putting enough effort into investigating an attack on a Kashmiri student. They protested under the name Jammu and Kashmir Students Association.
Assumed on September 28, in Jaipur city (Jaipur, Rajasthan), teachers staged a protest against the norms of the central government's new pension scheme.

Assumed on September 28, Jaipur city (Jaipur, Rajasthan), electricity department employees staged a demonstration as part of a government employee strike against the suspension of colleagues and pay-related discrepancies.
On 28 September 2018, in Adukkamparai town (Vellore, TN), family members of man who committed suicide staged a demonstration condemning a police inspector on charges of abetting suicide.
On 28 September 2018, in Hyderabad city (Hyderabad, Telangana), Congress workers staged a demonstration demanding to see the TPCC president.

On 28 September 2018, in Seetharampuram village in Chilkur tehsil (Suryapet, Telangana), beneficiaries public housing staged a demonstration and scuffled with housing occupants because they were found ineligible to live in the housing.
On 28 September 2018, in Warangal town (Warangal, Telangana), Congress activists staged a demonstration demanding action against those who attacked the residents of Sundarayya Nagar-II Colony.

On 28 September 2018, the Confederation of All India Traders called a bandh and staged a protest in Lucknow (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh) against the sealing driving in and Walmart's role in the retail sector.
On 28 September 2018, 9 people were injured in a clash between two groups in Bhokaheri village (Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh), apparently over a three year old marriage. No further details.

As reported on September 28, a team of Odiya students and teachers was assaulted by local students in Rashtriya Sanskrit Sansthan University, in Agartala city (West Tripura district, Tripura). The Odiya group had questioned the locals how the money given for Teachers Day celebrations on campus was spent.

On 28 September 2018, BJP Mahila Morcha women activists protested and burnt the effigy of Agriculture Minister (Pradeep Maharathy) in Balasore city (Balasore district, Odisha), protesting his derogatory remarks against women.
On 28 September 2018, locals gheraoed the municipality office in Basudevpur (Bhadrak district, Odisha), alleging irregularities in preparation of ration card beneficiary list.

On 28 September 2018, Swar Sena protesters waved black fags at an Union Minister and BJP member in Bhagalpur district (Bihar), to protest against the restoration of the provision for immediate arrest under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

On 28 September 2018, BJP Mahila Morcha women activists protested and burnt posters of the Chief Minister and of the Agriculture Minister (Pradeep Maharathy) in Bhubaneswar city (Khordha district, Odisha), protesting the later's derogatory remarks against women.

On 28 September 2018, AAP members and farmers unions staged a protest in Chhapar village (Ludhiana, Punjab) demanding legalisation of opium cultivation in Punjab. They allegedly scattered opium seeds during the protest.

On 28 September 2018, lawyers of the Orissa High Court locked up the main gate of the court and burnt the effigy of the Chief Justice of Odisha High Court and the Supreme Court, in Cuttack city (Cuttack district, Odisha). They had been protesting for almost a month after a lawyer was attacked and critically injured by police officials on August 28.

On 28 September 2018, the students protestors under the banner of Bodoland Students Union (BSU) blocked a three-member inquiry team to enter the Bodoland University (BU), in Debargaon village (Kokrajhar district, Assam). Students had been demanding the oust of the Vice Chancellor (in-charge).

On 28 September 2018, members of the Dhanbad District Chemists and Druggists Association demonstrated at Randhir Verma Chowk in Dhanbad city (Dhanbad district, Jharkhand), in support of a bandh organised by the Jharkhand Druggist and Chemist Association (JDCA), against online trading of medicines.

On 28 September 2018, a group of over 50 social workers and residents under the Rashtriya Nirman Sena staged more than four hours of jal-satyagraha at Kanke Dam in Kanke city (Ranchi district, Jharkhand). The group protested against the condition of the reservoir, one of the main sources of water supply for Ranchi residents.

On 28 September 2018, more than 200 fishers entered into the prohibited Nalabana bird sanctuary area in Chilika Lake, near Krushnaprasad village (Puri district, Odisha), protesting illegal prawn gheries and nets. The fishers had been demanding action from administration on several demands.

On 28 September 2018, family and residents of Rajiv Colony staged a protest at the Civil Hospital in Panchkula (Panchkula, Haryana) demanding action against the doctors involved in the case of an Asha worker who died in childbirth the day before. They claim doctors' negligence resulted in her death.
On 28 September 2018, women activists from the BJP Mahila Morcha took out a protest rally in Phulbani city (Kandhamal district, Odisha), protesting the recent rape and murder of a nine-year-old girl.

On 28 September 2018, women activists from the BJP Mahila Morcha protested and staged a road blockade on National Highway 53 near Gopalpur area (Kandhamal district, Odisha), protesting the recent rape and murder of a nine-year-old girl.

On 28 September 2018, hundreds of activists of Jagannath Sena, a regional conservation outfit, staged dharna in front of the Shree Jagannath Temple in Puri city (Puri district, Odisha), after the Temple Administration announced that the report on the Brahma Parivartan Fiasco will not be made public.

On 28 September 2018, more than 200 people, comprising widows, differently abled and elderly people, gathered near Raj Bhavan in Ranchi city (Ranchi district, Jharkhand), to demand a better system by which eligible residents of Jharkhand weren't denied pension.

On 28 September 2018, BJP Mahila Morcha women activists protested and burnt the effigy of Agriculture Minister (Pradeep Maharathy) in Salepur city (Cuttack district, Odisha), protesting his derogatory remarks against women.

On 28 September 2018, students from DAV University in Dehradun staged a demonstration in Garhwal University (Srinagar, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand) against a delay in exams. The demonstration turned violent, with students beating administration and security officials on the campus. The students seem to have been aligned with ABVP, who called a strike over the event.

On 28 September 2018, chemists and druggists staged a protest in Itanagar city (Papum Pare district, Arunachal Pradesh), in support of a strike announced by the All India Organisation of Chemists and Druggists against online sale of medicines.

On 29 September 2018, more than 100 BJP-MM (women's wing of BJP) members held a protest at Islampur city (Uttar Dinajpur district, WB) to demand a CBI probe after two youths were killed on September 20, during a clash with the police in Islampur.

On 29 Sep, rioters clashed with military forces in the Redwani Bala area (Kulgam, J&K), during a demonstration against the military establishing a camp in Redwani Bala and allegedly damaging property.
On 29 September 2018, in Visakhapatnam city (Visakhapatnam, AP), TDP activists staged a demonstration against the Rafale aircraft deal.

On 29 September 2018, in Surat city (Surat, Gujarat), BJP activists and local residents staged a demonstration to protest against the their party's role in the number of alcohol-related deaths in the area.

On 29 September 2018, Sikh groups continued to demonstrate against the decision for the CM not to visit and hold prayers at Dacher village (Karnal, Uttar Pradesh). They later got violent and damaged property and raised pro-Khalistan signs.

On 29 Sep, the All J&K Rehri Khokha and Phari Trade Union (AJKRKPTU) staged a march from Transport Nagar to the JDA Office in Jammu city (J&K), in protest over the JDA's demolition drive targeting rehris and temporary kokhas.

On 29 Sep, students from Bani Government Degree College marched to the SDM Office in Bani town (Kathua, J&K) in protest against an assistant professor who they accuse of anti-national activity after he refused to stand during the national anthem.

On 29 Sep, rioters clashed with military forces in the Khudwani ghat area (Kulgam, J&K), during a demonstration against the military establishing a camp in Redwani Bala and allegedly damaging property. Seven rioters received minor injuries during the clashes.
On 29 Sep, the family of a kidnapped girl blocked the Mendhar-Jammu road in the Mendhar area (Poonch, J&K), calling for police to return the girl to them after her recovery from Chandigarh.
On 29 Sep, higher secondary school students staged a protest at the Press Club in Srinagar city (J&K), calling for a delay in exams due to their non-completion of the course syllabus.

On 29 September 2018, in Pune city (Pune, Maha), labourers staged a demonstration demanding reinstatement and also clashed with police after their employer closed gates of the business and wouldn't let the workers in or out. Police arrested 70 activists.
On 29 September 2018, in Navi Mumbai town (Thane, Maha), residents staged a demonstration demanding immediate restoration of the town water supply.

Assumed on September 29, in Hyderabad city (Hyderabad, Telangana), Muslim legal scholars staged a protest to condemn the Union government for trying to take away the rights guaranteed to Muslims in the Constitution of India.

On 29 September 2018, BJP Mahila Morcha women activists staged a protest and burnt the effigy of Agriculture Minister (Pradeep Maharathy) in Angul city (Angul district, Odisha), protesting his derogatory remarks against women.

On 29 September 2018, a mob torched a van in Asurali village (Bhadrak district, Odisha), on the suspicion that cattle were being smuggled to West Bengal. The group also vandalized other vehicles and staged a road blockade.

actor2: Police Forces of India (2014-) Government Railway Police
text: On 29 September 2018, Government Railway Police are accused of assaulting a group of students travelling on the Banda-Jhansi train (location unclear, coded at Banda, Uttar Pradesh). The group argued with police over seating on the train, then resisted eviction from the train before the GPR allegedly assaulted them.

On 29 Sep, local election candidates - including a local BJP leader - forcibly entered and occupied the office of the Block Development Officer in Bandipora district town (J&K) and verbally abused officials. During the action, the candidate made unreported accusations against the officials.

On 8 October 2018, farmers aligned with BKU (Dakaunda) staged a protest in front of the DC's office in Fatehgarh Sahib (Fatehgarh Sahib, Punjab) and blocked traffic on the Sirhind-Chandigarh road as a protest over the government's actions against farmers burning stubble in their fields.

On 8 October 2018, rioters clashed with police near the near Govt Girls Higher Secondary School in Bandipora district town (J&K). The clash occurred during a JRL shutdown across the Kashmir Valley, against panchayat and municipal elections.

On 8 October 2018, rioters pelted stones at a polling station in the Bazar Mohalla area of Budgam district town (J&K). The rioting occurred during a JRL shutdown across the Kashmir Valley, against panchayat and municipal elections.

On 8 October 2018, members of the Valmiki community (part of the Dalit caste group), including the Samaj president and other committee members, protested against the Jalalabad city police at the station (Jalalabad, Fazilka, Punjab), claiming that police were shielding individuals accused of attacking three young men in Jalalabad in August.

On 8 October 2018, farmers associated with the Kul Hind Kisan Sangharsh Talmul Committee gheraoed the market committee office in Tarn Taran (Tarn Taran, Punjab) in protest against the government for failing to support farmers through minimum support pricing and other complaints.

On 8 October 2018, the Water Supply and Sanitation Talmel Sangharsh Committee staged a protest at the district revenue office in Bathinda (Bathinda, Punjab), against the office and alleging corruption, as well as its failure to pay bills to employees such as medial allowance, DA, and others.

On 8 October 2018, BKU (Sidhupur) members staged a protest and gheraoed the market committee office in Goniana Mandi (Bathinda, Punjab). They protested against the government for failing to start purchasing cotton from farmers.

On 8 October 2018, unidentified persons threw a petrol bomb at the residence of a BJP candidate in the Mir Sahib Mohallah area of Baramulla district town (J&K). The bomb exploded outside the house without any reported damage. The candidate was not at home at the time.
On 8 October 2018, the BJP staged a protest in Bathinda (Bathinda, Punjab) and burnt the effigy of CM Capt Amarinder Singh's government for failing to reduce the state fuel tax.

On 8 October 2018, the Powercom and Transco Contract Employees Union staged a protest in Bathinda (Bathinda, Punjab) against the state government and the Powercom company over retrenchment of contract workers.

On 8 October 2018, three Public Health Engineering Department casual workers received accidental burns when they set fire to tyres during a demonstration at Doda district town (J&K). The workers were demonstrating against the non-payment of wages.
On 8 October 2018, in Chittoor town (Chittoor, AP), social health activists under the aegis of FTI staged a demonstration demanding an increase in salaries.

On 8 October 2018, the BJP staged a protest dharna at police station #1 in Jalandhar (Jalandhar, Punjab) over charges made against BJP leaders in the district over land disagreements and illegal construction, on Oct 3.

On 8 October 2018, need-based and casual workers for the Power Development Department staged a protest in Jammu city (J&K), calling for the release of unpaid wages. The rally took place during a 72-hour strike by the workers.

On 8 October 2018, in Ongole town (Prakasam, AP), Mala Mahanadu leaders staged a protest demanding that the government immediately fill the SC/ST backlog of posts pending. (Mala are a Dalit caste group.)

On 8 October 2018, the Punjab University Campus Students' Council staged a protest at the VC's office on campus in Chandigarh (Chandigarh, Punjab) demanding transparency in hostel allotments for students.

On 8 October 2018, police resorted to a baton charge to quell election violence between rival PDP and BJP activists in Poonch district town (J&K). During the clash, rival activists had beaten a BJP activists.
On 8 October 2018, in Thane town (Thane, Maha), MNS workers assaulted a north Indian man from Bihar because he was accused of sexually assaulting a young girl.

On 8 October 2018, students of the Dr. HS Judge Institute of Dental Sciences and Hospital and the Punjab University Campus Students' Council staged a protest at the dental college in Chandigarh (Chandigarh) against the fee hike for second year students.

On 8 October 2018, teachers under the association of Punjabi University Contractual Teachers' Association staged a protest and burnt copies of their degrees on campus in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab). They demanded either regularisation or a daily allowance in addition to their basic salary.

On 8 October 2018, no injuries were reported when rioters clashed with police in the old area of Baramulla district town (J&K) during local elections. The clash occurred during a JRL shutdown across the Kashmir Valley, against panchayat and municipal elections.
On 8 October 2018, Gau Rakshak Dal members attacked and beat up two men for transporting 23 bulls, near Namaste Chowk in Karnal (Karnal, Haryana). The two men were handed to police and arrested.

On 8 October 2018, students and local villagers held protest demonstration at Mohalla Tallian Government Primary School in Ramnagar tehsil (Udhampur, J&K), demanding repairs to the damaged school building and increased provisions for the school.

On 8 October 2018, in Wyra town (Khammam, Telangana), TRS (presently known as BRS) and Congress clashed while TRS (presently known as BRS) activists staged a demonstration in support of their party candidate. The number of injuries was not reported.
On 8 October 2018, in Chennai city (Chennai, TN), students staged a protest against the construction of a wall that would curb free movement along the three campuses.

On 8 October 2018, members of the Bengali community took out a protest rally against the NRC state coordinator, in Silchar city (Cachar district, Assam). They also demanded the passage of the Citizenship (Amendment) Bill 2016. The protest was taken as part of the Mahalaya festival.

actor2: Military Forces of India (2014-) Rashtriya Rifles
text: On 8 October 2018, rioters clashed with government forces during a joint Rashtriya Rifles, police and CRPF CASO at Jalalabad village in Sopore tehsil (Baramulla, J&K).
On 8 October 2018, in Mankhurd town (coded to Mumbai Suburban - Kurla, Maharashtra), residents and Shiv Sena leaders staged a protest against the proposed Mumbai Metro car shed at Mandale.
On 8 October 2018, CPM members held a protest and staged a chakka jam at Victory tunnel in Shimla (Shimla, Himachal Pradesh) over the recent increase in bus fare in the area.
On 8 October 2018, the Mandi District Congress Committee staged a protest in Mandi (Mandi, Himachal Pradesh) against the BJP government over inflation.
On 8 October 2018, in Mumbai-Fort in Mumbai (coded to Mumbai City, Maharashtra), NCP activists staged a protest against an event to felicitate Sanatan Sanstha lawyer Sanjeev Punalekar.
On 8 October 2018, Congress workers staged a protest in Nurpur (Kangra, Himachal Pradesh) at the mini-secretariat over the high prices of fuel and blaming the Modi-BJP government.

On 8 October 2018, Congress workers in Chamba (Chamba, Himachal Pradesh) staged a protest against the central and state governments over 'faulty' policies, especially impacting commodity and transportation prices.

On 8 October 2018, in Thanjavur town (Thanjavur, TN), residents staged a protest against the closure of a manned level crossing gate between Alakkudi and Thanjavur in Tiruchi-Thanjavur broad gauge section.

On 8 October 2018, sanitation workers for the East Delhi Municipal Corporation staged a demonstration under the name Swachhata Karmachari Union at Jantar Mantar in Delhi - Connaught Place (New Delhi, Delhi) against the government over salary delays and accusing PM Modi and CM Kejriwal of ignoring their problems. Police allegedly used 'mild force,' including lathi charge, to disperse the group. Some reports say the demonstrators broke barricades and threw stones at police who tried to stop them from marching towards Parliament.
On 8 October 2018, BJP members staged a protest at the Patel Chowk in Jalandhar (Jalandhar, Punjab) and burnt an effigy of CM Amarinder Singh demanding that the state lower the price of fuel.

On 8 October 2018, UP state employees staged a protest on the call of various labour organisations in Lucknow (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh) demanding the restoration of the old pension scheme, among other labour demands. Teachers from state-run primary and secondary schools in UP also staged a protest at Lucknow (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh) demanding restoration of their old pension. (Unclear whether these two were part of the same protest.)
On 8 October 2018, the BJP staged a protest in Mohali (Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab) against the government for failing to cut the VAT rate on fuel in the face of high prices.

On 8 October 2018, garbage collectors staged a protest demonstration in Sector 22 of Chandigarh city (Chandigarh) against the Municipal Corporation, who they blamed for the death of a garbage collector earlier that day. The man collapsed and died after an argument with MC staff over his identity card.

On 8 October 2018, students from Banaras Hindu University gheraoed the vehicle of Union minister Anupriya Patel during a visit to the campus in Varanasi (Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh), demanding the withdrawal of amendments to the SC/ST act.
On 8 October 2018, youth wings of around 14 political parties, notably IYC, staged a protest in New Delhi (Delhi) against unemployment, high commodity prices, and the Rafale jet deal.

Around 8 October 2018, BJP members staged a protest behind the mini secretariat in Ludhiana (Ludhiana, Punjab), where Youth Congress members had painted the slogan 'the PM is a thief', against PM Modi. They demanded that a FIR be lodged against Congress leaders over the slogan campaign.

On 8 October 2018, members of Shikshamitra Krantikari Mahasangh (teachers) staged a protest in Dehradun (Dehradun, Uttar Pradesh) and attempted to march to the state secretariat in demand for increased salary and regular jobs. Police detained them before they could reach the secretariat.

On 8 October 2018, a student collective (Pinjra Tod) at Delhi University in Timarpur area of Delhi (Delhi) staged a protest over the hostel curfew for female students at the university. They attempted to break locks on some university buildings and blocked traffic on Mail Road.
On 8 October 2018, Congress staged protests across Uttar Pradesh over the recent attacks on north Indians in Gujarat after a rape there which was believed to be committed by a migrant.

On 8 or 9 October, Congress staged a protest march in Lucknow (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh) against the recent attacks on migrant workers in Gujarat, after a rape there which was believed to be committed by a migrant. They also burnt an effigy of the BJP government and protested against the BJP for failing to act on the matter. Police stopped the march near Lal Bahadur Shastri Marg - no indication of violence.

On 8 October 2018, a group of around 25 men allegedly attacked 4 students at Gandhi Mohamad Ali Memorial Inter College in Ballia district (Uttar Pradesh). The students claim they were attacked by men with lathis chanting pro-Pakistan slogans.

On 10 September 2018, the police resorted to lathicharge to control a mob of CPI(ML) workers in Nawada city, (Nawada district, Bihar), who were enforcing a Bharat Bandh called by the Congress and opposition parties against the hike in fuel prices.

As reported on October 9, locals protested in front of a police station in Kantabanji city (Balangir district, Odisha), demanding the arrest of Kantabanji MLA (Ayub Khan), after a video of him misbehaving with a senior citizen has surfaced.

On 9 October 2018, in Pangode village in Nedumangad Tehsil in (Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala), SFI and Kerala Student Union activists of Mar Ivanios College clashed during an electoral victory demonstration.

On 9 October 2018, in Aruvikkara village in Nedumangad tehsil (Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala), SFI and Kerala Student Union activists of Mar Ivanios College clashed during an electoral victory demonstration.

On 9 October 2018, a tribal kangaroo court forced a farmer to chop off all fingers on his 66-year-old father's hands in Radhakrishnapur village (Birbhum district, West Bengal), before a crowd of 100 that included the village headman. The court accused the elderly man of witchcraft following claims he prayed 'moving his fingers on the floor'.

On 9 October 2018, in Porsa village in Porsa tehsil (Morena, MP), a mob threw stones at a non-Gujarati migrant labourer, hitting him and leaving his property damaged. Migrant labourers have been targeted after a 14-month-old girl from Himmatnagar in Sabarkantha was allegedly raped by a migrant labourer.

On 9 October 2018, a group of at least three people attacked and beat four bailiffs with their belts in Cheecha Bhakna village under Gharinda police station (Amritsar, Punjab). The officials were taking possession of land per a court order after the resolution of a land dispute.

On 9 October 2018, the ABVP led a student demonstration at Jammu University in Jammu city (J&K), protesting against a lack of student amenities. Protesters blocked the university's main road during the demonstration.

On 9 October 2018, need-based and casual workers for the Power Development Department staged a protest at Jewal Chowk in Jammu city (J&K), calling for the release of unpaid wages. The rally took place during a 72-hour strike by the workers.

On 9 October 2018, students blocked the Jammu-Poonch national highway near Akhnoor town (Jammu, J&K), in protest against transporters refusing them service. The students alleged that they have been refused service due to their student discounts resulting in less income for transporters on crowded routes.
On 9 October 2018, health workers staged a protest march in Bandipora district (J&K), calling for an investigation into the alleged murder of a local nurse by her in-laws.

On 9 October 2018, Bajrang Dal activists staged a protest at the Press Club in Jammu city (J&K) against the alleged humiliation of Sant-Mahants in Uttar Pradesh (UP). The protest was a response to UP police arresting a Hindu Mahant who had been demanding the early construction of the Ram Temple in Ayodhya.
On 9 October 2018, contractors for the Banihal block of the Rural Development Authority staged a protest in Srinagar city (J&K), demanding the release of outstanding payments.
On 9 October 2018, an independent candidate in the local municipal elections escaped unharmed when unknown persons threw a petrol bomb at his residence in the Hawal area of Srinagar city (J&K).
On 9 October 2018, no injuries were reported when unknown persons pelted stones at the residence of a candidate at Giraj village (Ganderbal, J&K). The residence was damaged by the incident.
On 9 October 2018, the United Forum of Bank Unions staged a protest at Bahu Plaza in Jammu city (J&K) against the government's announcement that they would merge public sector banks.

On 9 October 2018, the Peoples' Resurgence and Justice Alliance (PRJA) along with Apunba Meira Paibi members staged a sit-in protest at Phayeng Bazar village (Imphal West district, Manipur), in protest against the arrest of a PRJA member. The man was arrested for participating in a protest on September 27.
On 9 October 2018, in Srikakulam town (Srikakulam, AP), Asha workers and CITU leaders staged a protest demanding that they be paid enhanced wages. Police arrested 319 activists.

On 9 October 2018, youths vandalized the Pradhanpali Grid office in Bargarh city (Bargarh district, Odisha), against the frequent unscheduled power cuts in the area. The youths reported the police physically assaulted them. 10 youths involved in the incident were arrested.
On 9 October 2018, in Thoothukudi town (Thoothukudi, TN), bank employees staged a protest demanding that the plan for merger of Dena Bank, Vijaya Bank and Bank of Baroda be dropped.

On 9 October 2018, the Punjab Students Union staged a protest at MR Government College in Fazilka (Fazilka, Punjab) against the police, claiming they have been slow to respond to a suicide case in Aligarh village, and in doing so are shielding Congress leaders who have been accused of abetment.

On 9 October 2018, in Thiruvananthapuram city (Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala), SFI and Kerala Student Union activists of Mar Ivanios College clashed during an electoral victory demonstration. Police intervened and the rioters attacked them, leaving six policemen injured.

On 9 October 2018, teachers staged a protest as part of their ongoing agitation against the state education minister in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab), and burnt an effigy of Ed Minister Soni at the DC's office there. They also burnt the suspension orders issued for 5 union leaders the day before, declaring that the suspension would not end their protests.

On 9 October 2018, arhtiyas (market commission agents) attacked a group of protesting farmers in the Patti grain market in Tarn Taran (Tarn Taran, Punjab). The farmers were protesting in the market claiming exploitation of farmers by market operatives. One leader severely injured.

On 9 October 2018, in Tirunelveli town (Tirunelveli, TN), students led by SFI at Manonmaniam Sundaranar University staged a demonstration over electoral victories and pushed barriers onto police. Police used lathi charge to disperse the demonstrators and 12 activists were arrested.

On 9 October 2018, family of a woman who was killed in a road accident near Hartej Hospital on 7 October staged a protest and gheraoed the Ranjit Ave police station in Amritsar (Amritsar, Punjab) demanding that police taken action in the case, saying the person should be booked for murder.
On 9 October 2018, in Ahmedabad city (Ahmedabad, Gujarat), automobile workers staged a protest demanding that the contract system be abolished.

On 9 October 2018, the Joint Teachers' Morcha staged a protest and burnt the effigy of several state officials at Hanuman Chowk in Bathinda city (Bathinda, Punjab). They protested against the government for cutting salaries of contract teachers, and demanded regularisation on full salary.

On 9 October 2018, parents of students clashed with the police outside a school in Kolkata city (Kolkata district, West Bengal). The parents were demonstrating after knowing a 5-year-old girl was molested by a teacher. They pelted stones at the teachers and the police, who resorted to lathicharge.

On 9 October 2018, teachers associated with the 5178 Master Cadre Union, the SSA/RMSA Teachers' Union, SC/BC Teachers' Union, and Computer Teachers' Union staged a candlelight protest march from Baradari Garden to Kothi Road in Nawanshahr town (Nawanshahr, Punjab). They protested against the government over the salary reduction and demanded regularisation on full salary.
Assumed on October 9, in Bhopal town (Bhopal, MP), Bharatiya Kisan Union (BKU) activists staged a protest demanding that rates of milk purchased from farmers be increased.

On 9 October 2018, the United Forum of Bank Unions staged a protest at the State Bank of India, Fountain Chowk in Ludhiana (Ludhiana, Punjab), against the merger of three major banks. The group claims it is an unsound financial strategy to consolidate the banks and would negatively impact employees.

On 9 October 2018, a woman was killed at Sheohar village under Dumra police station area (Sitamarhi district, Bihar), on the suspicion of being a sorcerer. The victim's three brothers-in-law and a sister-in-law were arrested, accused of slitting open her throat. Another, who persuaded the family members that the woman should be killed because she was a witch, was also arrested.

On 9 October 2018, the All-India Accredited Social Health Activists Workers Union staged a protest march from Bus stand to Fountain Chowk in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab), demanding an increase in salary. They had planned to march to the Chief Ministers' residence, but were stopped by police deployment at Fountain Chowk.

On 9 October 2018, at least two midday meal workers were injured when police used batons to disperse a crowd of protesters, near the state guest house in Morabadi, Ranchi city (Ranchi district, Jharkhand). The group of workers were demanding restoration of their services, and a monthly remuneration of Rs 18,000.

On 9 October 2018, in Kishangarh town (Ajmer, Rajasthan), Central University of Rajasthan at Kishangarh students staged a demonstration and broke down the gates at their hostel against surveillance rules in the girls' hostels.
On 9 October 2018, around 150 teachers went on mass leave and staged a protest in Ranchi University, Ranchi city (Jharkhand), demanding implementation of the Seventh Pay Commission guidelines.
On 9 October 2018, in Tumakuru town (Tumakuru, Karnataka), Anganwadi workers staged a protest demanding that the government their demands for better hours among other accommodations.
On 9 October 2018, in Bagalkot town (Bagalkot, Karnataka), Anganwadi workers staged a protest demanding that the government their demands for better hours among other accommodations.

Around 9 October 2018, the BKU staged a protest at the new grain market in Kurukshetra (Kurukshetra, Haryana) against the alleged monopoly of rice millers and commissioners which exploits farmers in the market.
On 9 October 2018, in Bidar town (Bidar, Karnataka), Anganwadi workers staged a protest demanding that the government their demands for better hours among other accommodations.
On 9 October 2018, students staged a protest during the syndicate body meeting for Punjabi University in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab) demanding 24 hour access to hostels for students.

On 9 October 2018, contract teachers associated with the Punjabi University Constituent Colleges Teachers Association staged a protest during the syndicate body meeting for Punjabi University in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab) demanding regularisation.
On 9 October 2018, in Raichur town (Raichur, Karnataka), Anganwadi workers staged a protest demanding that the government their demands for better hours among other accommodations.
On 9 October 2018, in Ramanagara town (Ramanagara, Karnataka), Anganwadi workers staged a protest demanding that the government their demands for better hours among other accommodations.

On 9 October 2018, members of the newly-formed UP-Bihar Ekta Manch staged a protest march in Sigra area of Varanasi (Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh) against the recent violence in Gujarat against UP migrants and also against PM Modi, who represents Varanasi. The protests included slogans demanding Modi and Gujaratis leave the area.

On 9 October 2018, in Gulbarga city (Kalaburagi, Karnataka), a mob pelted a car and attempted to set it on fire after the driver accidentally killed a young woman. The police intervened and arrested seven of the rioters.

On 9 October 2018, several students were injured in an attack on the Democratic Students Organisation students protesting at Punjabi University in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab) in demand for 24 hour hostel access for women. The attackers are unidentified, but DSO members accuse the students in the PE department and those aligned with other parties. BKU (Ekta Dakaunda) leaders later joined the students in solidarity after the attack.

On 9 October 2018, United Forum of Bank Unions members staged a protest in Ludhiana (Ludhiana, Punjab) against the government for its decision to merge three major banks. The employees claim the merge is a financial risk and would negatively impact employees.

On 9 October 2018, residents of Lippa village (Kinnaur, Himachal Pradesh) staged protests and demonstrations against officials from the HP Power Corporation Limited, who came to the village in preparation for the 130 MW Kashang Stage II and III power project which is meant to be completed in the area. The villagers successfully drove away the officials and accompanying police officers.
On 10 October 2018, students held a protest at Malda town (Maldah district, WB) over no program being organized in the college.

On 10 October 2018, in Morthala village of Chotila tehsil (Surendranagar, Gujarat), two groups of villagers clashed over two people from different communities eloping. Four people were injured and three houses were set on fire.

On 10 October 2018, two policemen were seriously injured in a clash with locals at Balitika-Konwarpur area (Lakhimpur district, Assam), when a police team from Dolaghat Police Outpost tried to arrest a man wanted for running a fake gold racket.
On 10 October 2018, in Ammathi town in Virajpet tehsil (Kodagu, Karnataka), farmers staged a protest during a one-hour bandh demanding a loan waiver for coffee, areca, and pepper farmers.

On 10 October 2018, the All J&K SRTC Volunteer Retired Employees Association staged a protest at the Exhibition Ground in Jammu city (J&K) demanding the release of unpaid wages and pension entitlements.

On 10 October 2018, need-based and casual workers for the Power Development Department staged another day of protest at Jammu city (J&K), calling for the release of unpaid wages. The rally took place during a 72-hour strike by the workers.

On 10 October 2018, polling station workers staged a protest at the Revenue Training College in the Bemina area of Srinagar city (J&K), accusing the administration of leaving them waiting for the whole day without food.

On 10 October 2018, rioters clashed with police in the Parimpora area of Srinagar city (J&K) during local elections. The clash occurred during a JRL shutdown across the Kashmir Valley, against panchayat and municipal elections.

On 10 October 2018, rioters clashed with police in the Janglat Mandi, KP Road, Khanabal and downtown areas of Anantnag district town (J&K) during local elections. The clash occurred during a JRL shutdown across the Kashmir Valley, against panchayat and municipal elections.

On 10 October 2018, students clashed with the police inside the Manipur University campus, in Imphal city (Imphal West district, Manipur), after a group of students tried to storm the Administrative (A) Block. The students were demanding the release of arrested varsity teachers and students. 17 students were arrested.
On 10 October 2018, the All Assam Students' Union (AASU) staged a protest rally in Kalaigaon city (Udalguri district, Assam), against anomalies in the newly-inaugurated Kalaigaon Model Hospital.

On 10 October 2018, the All Assam Scheduled Caste Students' Union (AASCSU) staged a protest near the Deputy Commissioner's office in Golaghat city (Golaghat district, Assam), demanding resolution of various problems of the Scheduled Caste community.
On 10 October 2018, in Thiruvananthapuram town (Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala), Nair Service Society staged a protest against the Supreme Court's ruling on the entry of women in the Sabarimala temple.
On 10 October 2018, in Changanassery town (Kottayam, Kerala), Indian Union Muslim League staged a protest in support of the Supreme Court's ruling on the entry of women in the Sabarimala temple.

Assumed on October 10, in Kasaragod town (Kasaragod, Kerala), students at Central University of Kerala staged a demonstration following the row over the suicide attempt of a post graduate student October 9 who was expelled.

On 10 October 2018, in Pathanamthitta town (Pathanamthitta, Kerala), Hindu activists staged a protest against the Supreme Court verdict permitting entry of women of all ages into the Ayyappa temple at Sabarimala.
On 10 October 2018, in Dharmapuri town (Dharmapuri, TN), government pensioners staged a protest demanding exemption of pension from income tax ambit.
On 10 October 2018, in Hosur town (Krishnagiri, TN), government pensioners staged a protest demanding exemption of pension from income tax ambit.

On 10 October 2018, in Vadodara city (Vadodara, Gujarat), a mob of locals clashed with group of non-Gujarati migrant labourers, leaving several people injured. Migrant labourers have been targeted after a 14-month-old girl from Himmatnagar in Sabarkantha was allegedly raped by a migrant labourer.

On 10 October 2018, youths under the aegis of the central committee of Young Mizo Association (YMA) staged a demonstration at Vanapa Hall, in Aizawl city (Aizawl district, Mizoram), demanding the abolition of the Chakma Autonomous District Council (CADC).

On 10 October 2018, the State Bank of India Officers Association (North Eastern Circle) organized a demonstration and condolence program in Guwahati city (Kamrup Metropolitam district, Assam), after a woman service manager of SBI was shot dead by two unidentified men on October 9.

On 10 October 2018, members of the CPI organised a protest rally in front of the Deputy Commissioner's office in Sivasagar city (Sivasagar district, Assam), against rising prices of the petroleum products, essential commodities and the electricity charges.

On 10 October 2018, opposition parties took out a number of protest marches and burnt effigies of the Prime Minister and Gujarat CM in Patna city (Patna district, Bihar), to protest against attacks on migrant labourers in the aftermath of a rape of a 14-month-old girl in Gujarat on September 28. The parties included the Aam Aadmi Party, the Rashtriya Janata Dal, the Jan Adhikar Party, and the Lok Janshakti Party.

On 10 October 2018, the teachers protesting in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab) against the state government staged a large protest march in the city. The teachers are protesting against the decrease in their salary under regularisation, and demanding a meeting with the Chief Minister.

On 10 October 2018, students of GNDU University in Amritsar (Amritsar, Punjab) staged a protest on campus demanding the delay of student elections there claiming that teachers who were overseeing the procedure were playing favourites.

On 10 October 2018, the Punjab Pensioners Joint Front (Tarn Taran) staged a protest dharna in Tarn Taran (Tarn Taran, Punjab) demanding reintroduction of a cashless medical scheme and payment of DA instalments, among others.

On 10 October 2018, the Contract Employees Sangrash Morcha (Punjab) staged a protest and burnt an effigy of the state government in Bathinda (Bathinda, Punjab) over the reduction of salaries for RMSA/SSA contract teachers and retrenchment in other social programs. They demanded that contract teachers be regularised under current salaries.

On 10 October 2018, former employees associated with the Punjab Government Pensioners' Welfare Association, the Police Welfare Pension Association, PSPCL and PRTC staged a protest at Ambedkar Chowk in Bathinda (Bathinda, Punjab) against the state government, demanding a meeting with representatives as well as release of pending DA payments and the implementation of the Pay Commission report scheme.

On 10 October 2018, students organisations at Punjab University, including Students For Society and the All India Students Association, staged a protest on campus in Chandigarh (Chandigarh) in solidarity with the Punjabi University students who were attacked during a protest on 9 Oct. They demanded action against the attackers and the administration.

On 10 October 2018, the Punjabi University Contractual Teachers Association staged protests on Punjabi University campus in Patiala (Patiala, Punjab) including outside the VC's office. They were protesting against the 'meagre' raise in their basic salary and demanding full pay scale.

On 10 October 2018, the Sanyunkt Hindu Sangharsh Samiti (which includes Shiv Sena and Vishwa Hindu Parishad) forcibly closed meat and non-vegetarian shops in Gurgaon (Gurgaon, Haryana) in observance of Navratri. The group claims to have 'firmly requested' the closure of 300 shops, but shopkeepers claimed they were intimidated, threatened, or physically assaulted. Some reports refer to this as a concerted effort to close shops, while others call it a demonstration.

On 10 October 2018, the Delhi University Teachers' Association students and teachers staged a protest march from Mandi House to Parliament in Delhi - Parliament Street (New Delhi, Delhi) against the government's education policies towards DH, saying they undermine public funded education by encouraging fee increases and high enrolment. The group also protested the lack of action to address vacant teacher postings throughout the university system.

On 10 October 2018, the Pinjra Tod students collective staged a protest at DU's North Campus in TImarpur area of Delhi (Delhi) against hostel curfews for girls, and demanding 24 hour entry into hostels.
On 10 October 2018, BJYM members staged a protest march in Lucknow (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh) accusing Congress MLA Alpesh Thakor of fanning violence in Gujarat.
On 10 October 2018, 43 individuals allegedly harassed and 'manhandled' income tax officers during a site survey to textile businesses in Ludhiana (Ludhiana, Punjab).
